top_stories.title: Who Will the Nationals Protect from the Rule 5 Draft?

why_it_matters.text: The Nationals face a Tuesday deadline to finalize their 40-man roster ahead of the Rule 5 Draft. Expected protected players include Jarlin Susana, Travis Sykora, and Trey Lipscomb, while Alejandro Rosario is a significant gamble. Other players under consideration are Maxwell Romero Jr. and Cayden Wallace, with Elijah Green and Cristhian Vaquero potentially left exposed.

top_stories.title: Six Washington Nationals Whose 2026 Seasons Look Different Through xWAR

why_it_matters.text: A new statistic called xWAR, introduced by Thomas Nestico, offers a different perspective on the 2026 production of six Washington Nationals players. This expected version of wins above replacement provides an alternative evaluation for hitters and raises questions regarding their outlook for 2027.

top_stories.title: Washington Nationals legend Ryan Zimmerman makes his debut on the Hall of Fame ballot

why_it_matters.text: Washington Nationals legend Ryan Zimmerman has made his debut on the Hall of Fame ballot following his 2021 retirement. As the team's most iconic player, his name is a standout on this year's released ballot.

top_stories.title: Washington Nationals in the mix for two pitching targets

why_it_matters.text: The Washington Nationals are potentially pursuing two pitching targets during the offseason. While major signings like Evan Phillips and Jake Bauers have occurred, a larger free agent frenzy has not yet materialized despite the approaching lockout.

top_stories.title: The Washington Nationals Should Make Extending James Wood a Top Priority

why_it_matters.text: The Washington Nationals face a critical decision regarding whether to offer young superstar James Wood a long-term contract extension before his market value increases further.

top_stories.title: Five Teams Interested In A.J. Minter

why_it_matters.text: According to MLB Network's Jon Morosi, five teams—the Royals, Rangers, Phillies, Nationals, and Blue Jays—are interested in veteran left-hander A.J. Minter. Minter is a free agent following the expiration of his two-year, $22MM contract with the Mets.
